device.description: 10-bit 2 MSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads7039-q1.pdf (SBAS788A) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing requirements and switching characteristics (Figure 1), p.15 transfer characteristics, p.16 serial interface (Figure 34), p.17-19 offset calibration

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing), p.15 (Table 1 format), p.16 (Figure 34), p.17-19 (calibration)
notModeled: analog input; conversion is clocked by SCLK (the 10.5-SCLK conversion is not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
offset calibration frames (power-up: the first frame outputs zeros, which the 0 V code already is; the 32-SCLK calibration frame during normal operation)
tOut uses tD_CKDO 25 ns (AVDD 2.35-3.6 V, the whole AVDD range)
